note: P4329 (Pro 28:19) — who works his land has plenty of bread; who chases empty things has plenty of poverty.

dims.v: diligent labour — the honest work that brings plenty of bread
the working of one's land that yields plenty of bread — steady, honest labour, the opposite of chasing worthless fantasies
the empty pursuits it is set against (266606)
set against the vain chasing that brings poverty
abad (work/serve) — 'whoever WORKS his land will have plenty of bread' (cf 12:11); honest, steady labour feeds a man. Diligence brings plenty; fantasy brings want.
fantasy-chasing — the empty schemes that bring plenty of poverty
the following of worthless pursuits — the chasing of empty schemes and vain fantasies that yields not bread but a full measure of poverty
the honest labour it is set against (266601)
set against the diligent work that brings plenty

req (empty/worthless) — 'but he who follows WORTHLESS pursuits will have plenty of poverty'; chasing vain fantasies instead of working brings only want. Emergent: the get-rich fantasy as the road to poverty (cf 12:11; 28:22).
